# airflow-nomad

> Apache Airflow integration for Nomad-managed jobs

## Pages

- [airflow-nomad](index.html.md): Run and monitor Nomad-managed jobs from Apache Airflow.
- [Tutorial: run a Nomad job from Airflow](docs/src/tutorial.html.md): In this tutorial, we will define a Nomad batch job in airflow-config YAML and load it as an Airflow DAG.
- [How-to guides](docs/src/how-to.html.md): These guides cover common lifecycle and deployment configurations.
- [Why Airflow owns the Nomad job lifecycle](docs/src/explanation.html.md): Airflow coordinates a workflow, while Nomad schedules and supervises the processes that perform one long-running step. airflow-nomad keeps those roles separa...
- [API reference](docs/src/api.html.md): The public integration API is re-exported from airflow_nomad. Jobspec models are re-exported from nomad_pydantic and documented in its API reference.

- [airflow_nomad.NomadTask](docs/src/_build/airflow_nomad.NomadTask.html.md): Bases: Task, NomadTaskArgs
- [airflow_nomad.NomadOperatorArgs](docs/src/_build/airflow_nomad.NomadOperatorArgs.html.md): alias of NomadTaskArgs
- [airflow_nomad.NomadOperator](docs/src/_build/airflow_nomad.NomadOperator.html.md): alias of NomadTask
- [airflow_nomad.load_airflow_config](docs/src/_build/airflow_nomad.load_airflow_config.html.md): Compose a Hydra YAML configuration and validate it.
- [airflow_nomad.Nomad](docs/src/_build/airflow_nomad.Nomad.html.md): Bases: object
